# Upstream provenance

Source: https://github.com/c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll
Commit: `6f3ab83993ccc51df9331048a8f9a51bef19bc28` (package version 2.5.2).

`bili_readonly.py` extracts search, subtitle, metadata and storyboard functions from
`vendor/bilibili-mcp/mcp_server.py`. It keeps timestamp evidence, permits public
metadata access without login, sets network/size limits and validates CDN URLs.
No comment, message, upload, follow or favorite functions are copied.

Original copyrights: c1overzz and AGI_Ananas. Both MIT notices are included.
